transcript.answer:
Per the spec, Otto's Danish tool-budget message (`TOOL_BUDGET_MESSAGE_DA`) must not contain:
- a phone number, an email address or an opening hour
- the words `ring`, `minutter` or `timer`
- a persona name
- a `<` character
- any digit
- a claim to be a person (EU AI Act acceptance criterion)

It also has to be a non-empty string. The point is that it promises nothing concrete: no channel, time or person. It is written in the first person and uses Danish letters, commas and full stops only. Issue #498 notes that it currently ends with "En kollega vil følge op på din henvendelse.", which promises a follow-up. That issue is open and blocked on a decision about what the message may promise.

judgements.reason: The answer lists every item in the gold answer (no <, no digit, so no phone/email/opening hours; none of ring/minutter/timer; no persona name), and the extra details it adds do not contradict the gold.
